Use case: identity-preserve.
Create a single isolated full-body master asset of the STANDARD WHITE OUTLAW HYDRA MECH from Mass Effect Andromeda, for Armax Relay Clash.
Input1 is the high-detail gameplay photograph of the mech. Preserve that specific machine and its slightly three-quarter near-front standing stance: broad off-white weathered shell, three circular red optical/targeting elements in the forward triangular central cluster, squared twin shoulder launcher pods on articulated mounts, thick mechanical joints and ribbed black connectors, asymmetric forearms with the visible ranged assembly and articulated grasping hand, large separate thigh plates, jointed lower legs and wide industrial feet.
Input2 is a wider frontal gameplay view labelled Hydra. It corroborates the upper torso, both shoulder pods and small upper targeting head. Use it only to complete the tiny clipped upper edge of the leftmost shoulder pod in input1 and preserve the upper sensor construction. Input3 is another final gameplay frame with the Hydra name, for identity corroboration only. Do not copy lasers, explosions or other characters.
Reproduce visible asymmetry, armor breaks, relative limb lengths and equipment from these references. Keep the long heavy chassis and industrial construction; do not redesign it as a humanoid soldier or a sleek robot. Do not add equipment or fabricate new shoulder weapons. Preserve the mostly off-white, charcoal and worn brown-metal palette with restrained red lamps. The raised forearm is held as in input1, with no firing effects.
Render the whole machine at similar detail to the game model with neutral, even studio lighting. One full mech only, both feet and every shoulder pod completely in frame. Authentic transparent RGBA background with no environment, rocks, ground plane, shadow, display base, HUD, caption or text.
Leave wide clear margins above the highest shoulder pod and below both feet; the subject should use about 80 percent of canvas height. Do not crop or zoom.
